CustomField.description: Lookup to the Golden Record Knowledge Article Version produced by a merge, so the merged-source lineage can be surfaced via a native related list on the Knowledge record page (no custom component). Best-effort / display-only: the durable source of truth stays the version-independent Text master ids (Merged_Knowledge_Article_Id__c, Knowledge_Article_Id_1/2__c) — a lookup binds to a specific version, so after the survivor republishes it points at an archived-but-present prior version (still renders). deleteConstraint=SetNull so deleting the article is never blocked by a candidate pointing at it; orphaned rows are closed by KBDuplicateCandidateReconciler.
CustomField.label: Merged Article Version
